password_min_upper_case_chars.description: Minimum number of uppercase characters in new password.

password_min_lower_case_chars.description: Minimum number of lowercase characters in new password.

password_min_numeric_chars.description: Minimum number of numeric characters in new password.

password_min_special_chars.description: Minimum number of special characters in new password.

password_min_age_days.description: Period after a password is changed during which a password cannot be changed again, in days.

password_max_age_days.description: Period after which password must be changed, in days.

password_max_retries.description: Number of attempts users have to enter the correct password before their account is locked.

password_lockout_time_mins.description: Period of time for which users will be locked after entering their password incorrectly many times (specified by MAX_RETRIES), in minutes

password_history.description: Number of distinct passwords that a user must create before re-using a previous password

created_on.description: Date and time when the password policy was created.

database_name.description: Database in which the password policy is stored

schema_name.description: Schema in which the password policy is stored

owner.description: Role that owns the password policy

owner_role_type.description: The type of role that owns the password policy
